steps.content: A "ghost" draped in a white bedsheet wanders the corridor of the Bureau.
Beside the "ghost" stands Nightingale, wearing an all-business expression. Passing staff members and Sinners turn their heads, casting curious glances at the odd pair.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Graves, are you feeling better now?

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: With "this little one" protecting me, I feel much more comfortable. Thank you... Adjutant Nightingale.
A pair of pale, slender hands lift the "ghost's" veil, revealing a beautiful yet timid face. She looks at Nightingale with an apologetic expression.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: I'm sorry, um... is the detection device... still fixable?

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: And the... monitor? I'm so sorry... I thought it was some kind of evil soul-trapping device.
Recalling the chaos that erupted earlier during Graves's registration procedure, Nightingale smiles and pats her shoulder reassuringly.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Don't worry about it. I've already notified the maintenance team. This was my oversight; I should have explained the equipment's functions beforehand. I'm sorry for frightening you.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: In any case, your admission procedures are now complete. From this moment on, you are officially a Sinner detained by the Bureau.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Would you like me to show you around?
Graves nods, then immediately wraps herself in the bedsheet again, leaving only her eyes visible.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Are you planning to keep the bedsheet on?

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Yes. There are... so many people here.
Nightingale doesn't press the issue, simply guiding her forward at a deliberately slow pace.

Nightingale walks Graves through every detail—from the Outdoor Activity Area's schedules and access restrictions for different zones, down to the placement of surveillance cameras in the corridors—leaving no procedural stone unturned.
But Graves seems distracted, her attention fixed on the surveillance cameras with blinking red lights throughout the corridor. Hiding beneath the bedsheet, she whispers to herself.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Did he... also see all those silly things I just did?
steps.female_content: Did she... also see all those silly things I just did?

steps.content: Yawn... Is this our new arrival?
A drowsy voice interrupts Graves's thoughts. She spins around with surprising agility, taking two quick steps back to distance herself from whoever is speaking.
A lantern emitting an ethereal blue glow emerges through the solid wall, followed by a pale arm holding it.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...Letta, walking through walls is prohibited in the Bureau.
Nightingale rubs her forehead in resignation. Moments later, a blue-haired girl wearing pajamas fully shows herself in front of Graves.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Hehe, hello there. I'm Letta... Welcome to the Bureau.
Everything about the Bureau feels alien to Graves, and now this girl's sudden appearance leaves her with nowhere to retreat.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: ...Hello, I'm Graves.
Suppressing her urge to flee, Graves removes the bedsheet and forces a smile in response to Letta.
Finally able to get a clear look at Graves's face, Letta nods with satisfaction, her lips curving into a catlike smile.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Hmm... What a beautiful lady you are...
Graves doesn't bask in Letta's blunt praise; instead, she grows more anxious, self-consciously checking herself for anything unusual.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Is there something strange about me? Is it my clothes, or... my skin?
Puzzled by Graves's question, Letta leans in even closer and takes an exaggerated sniff.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Huh...? You don't seem strange to me at all... Hmm... You carry the night's scent with you... Do you love the night too?

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Yes, I like the night.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: The night makes me feel safe. The ghosts and spirits in the castle, they're all my friends.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Wait, did you just say... ghosts and spirits?! That sounds exactly like the kind of adventure I've been dreaming of!
Letta's previously drowsy eyes widen in excitement as she realizes she's found a kindred spirit.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: You don't find them scary?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Of course not! I've been wandering at night precisely so I could...
Nightingale clears her throat softly, interrupting Letta mid-sentence. Catching herself, Letta mysteriously pulls Graves aside.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Mm... I'll explain later. But you have to come find me—no matter how late! Promise me!
The girl with the lantern drifts away in an otherworldly manner, leaving Graves and Nightingale alone again in the corridor. Thanks to Letta's welcome, Graves stands a little easier now.
Nightingale shakes her head in resignation before turning to Graves to explain.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief told everyone you were coming and asked us to take good care of you.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Whether it's Letta or the others who greeted you on the way here, no one means you harm.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: He... is not coming to meet me?
steps.female_content: She... is not coming to meet me?

steps.content: Hearing Nightingale mention ${PlayerName}, Graves timidly voices the question that's been nagging at her since she arrived.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief is currently occupied managing the Morveth Castle incident's aftermath. The required paperwork has accumulated significantly, with no free time allowed right now.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Hmm... It's alright. I understand! Work comes first.
Graves understands why ${PlayerName} can't come to meet her, especially since the work is related to her case, but she can't help feeling a little disappointed inside.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: This place is completely different from the castle. Everyone is so friendly, and there are convenient modern facilities.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Even though I'm being detained, surely I can live a happier life here than before, right?
More importantly, she can be together with ${PlayerName}.
A future full of happiness should lie ahead, so why does her heart ache with this yawning emptiness?
The world outside the castle operates by rules she doesn't know. She's here for just one person, one promise. However, this place wasn't made for her.
Graves glances back the way they came—past the sealed doors and the sturdy bars. However comfortable the amenities, this place still exists to detain Sinners.
For normal people, these barriers offer protection. But for a monster like her, they stand as layers of cages—once inside, there's no escape.
In the castle's embrace, night was her ally—darkness meant invisibility, meant forgetting the face she feared was monstrous, so long as no one saw her.
But this place offers no such refuge. Unblinking security cameras trace her every movement, and sooner or later, they'll peel her secrets bare.
If one day everyone discovers her hideous appearance, would these people... still show her the same kindness?

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Do I... really deserve to stay here? Is this really where I can stay?
At this moment, she finds herself missing her castle and the friends she left behind.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Would it... be possible for me to go back sometime? Not to escape, just... to see my friends there. Occasionally.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Under normal circumstances, detained Sinners require authorization to leave Bureau premises. However, special requests may be submitted to Chief for consideration.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: If I submit a request... does that mean I'll get to see him?
steps.female_content: If I submit a request... does that mean I'll get to see her?

steps.content: Graves's eyes light up as she looks eagerly at Nightingale. With a gentle smile, Nightingale holds up her communication device.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief is quite busy and might not be able to review your request immediately. Would you like me to contact Chief and ask for an expedited response?
Graves hesitates for a moment. However fierce the longing to see him now, she swallows it—a proper bride doesn't add to her love's burdens, especially when he's already drowning in work.
steps.female_content: Graves hesitates for a moment. However fierce the longing to see her now, she swallows it—a proper bride doesn't add to her love's burdens, especially when she's already drowning in work.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: N-no need, it's not that urgent.

Minos Bureau of Crisis Control
Late at Night
It's already late at night, yet the office lights are still on. You stretch your stiff shoulders and glance at the time.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...It's already this late.
Your eyes sweep over the calendar on your desk, and you suddenly remember that today is Graves's first official day at the Bureau. Or technically speaking, it's already "yesterday."

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: First day at the Bureau... I wonder how she's settling in.
You've already spoken with Nightingale and asked other Sinners to look after her, but still... stepping from a place with no "people" into one filled with them everywhere...
Remembering how Graves cowered trembling behind you, you can't help but grow worried about her.

A tower of files mocks you from your desk, teetering with bureaucratic weight. Morveth Castle's transfer to Luminita's care still needs signing off and Graves's supervision plan demands prompt submission...
And that's not all—a backlog of overdue tasks lies waiting in your terminal. With a weary sigh, you drag your attention back to the documents before you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I'll go to her after I wrap these up.
Buzz... Buzz...
The lamp on your desk suddenly flickers, and in that heartbeat of darkness, you sense something watching from the shadows.
Maybe it's just your imagination, but the mournful sigh that ripples through your empty office sounds achingly real.
You jerk your head toward the sound but find no one in sight. Reminded of your time at the castle, you rub your eyes, trying to shake off the bone-chilling sensation that just ran through you.
You pick up your terminal to check, but there are no notifications.
You hold your breath and concentrate, straining for another trace of it—but the silence swallows everything whole. Not a creak, not a rustle. Just the deafening weight of nothingness.

With your thoughts interrupted, you decide to stand up and make a cup of coffee. The machine hums softly as the bitter aroma fills the room. Taking a sip, you feel the warm liquid soothe both your body and mind.

You return to your seat with the coffee, almost convinced you imagined it all. But as your eyes fall on the desktop, your heart suddenly tightens—have the items... slightly moved from their positions?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Am I just too tired?
You rub your strained eyes and glance toward the office door. It remains firmly shut, completely undisturbed.

Your hand tightly grips the coffee cup as you hope it's just overwork making your mind play tricks on you. At this point, you'd gladly welcome someone jumping out from under your desk to give you a "surprise" over facing this slow-drip dread of things not-quite-right alone.
After staring motionlessly at the door for a full minute, confirming it shows no signs of having been opened, you blink your strained eyes and pull out your chair to sit down.
But then, you find yourself unexpectedly sinking into a warm, vibrating soft cushion that wasn't there before.
You leap to your feet like a startled cat. A Syndicate curse slips through your lips, hanging in the Bureau's midnight hush.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Whose sick prank is this?!
A "list of suspects" flashes through your mind, and you cautiously call out a name.
No response.
But whoever it is, they clearly aren't done with you...
A cool breeze comes first, gently caressing your neck, carrying with it an inexplicable chill. Then the dawning horror: you never opened the window. Not tonight. Not when the forecast promised cold!

You rise and approach the window. It's half-open when it should be closed, with curtains gently swaying. In the hazy moonlight, you're shocked to see what looks like a figure clinging to the outside! Its shadow stretches and contorts, impossible to identify.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Whoever you are, this prank ends now!

You slide the curtains open with a swift motion, determined to catch whoever is playing these ghostly tricks. But there's no one behind them—only a note stuck to the window, written in what looks like fresh red ink: "LEAVE HERE."

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's red... Blood?
Before you can examine the writing more closely, a white shadow darts past in the window's reflection with startling speed!
You whirl around, but still catch no sight of the prankster. All you see is the empty corridor and the door slowly swinging shut.
Though the corridor is clearly empty, the lights begin flickering on one after another, like a trail of breadcrumbs in a horror movie deliberately laid out for you to follow.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Seems like I won't get through these files until I catch the "culprit" behind this prank.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And the office security system... definitely needs a thorough check.
You press your lips together in resigned determination and take your first step into the corridor.
Following the trail of lights, you arrive at a partially open door. Peering inside from the doorway, you find the room shrouded in complete darkness.
Scenes from horror movies flash through your mind—in those stories, people who enter such darkened rooms rarely survive to see the credits roll.
Do you really want to return to your office with that mysterious cushion and the note reading "LEAVE HERE" stuck to the window?
After weighing your options carefully, you decide to go in and investigate.
You slip sideways through the doorway and take a few careful steps forward, moving as silently as possible.
Intermittent rustling sounds echo within the room, as if someone is rummaging through belongings in search of something.
Before your eyes can adjust to the darkness, the sliver of light behind you slowly disappears. Click—the lock slides home.
In an instant, your internal alarm bell starts ringing at full volume.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Going this far?
You whirl back to the door, but it won't budge no matter what you try. You reach for your pocket, only to realize you've left your mobile terminal back in your office.
Your commotion at the door betrays your presence, and the faint, intermittent sounds from nearby suddenly cease completely.

Your eyes gradually adjust to the darkness, allowing you to barely make out your surroundings. Filing cabinets line the walls, with miscellaneous items piled throughout the room, cluttering the pathways.
You recall Nightingale once mentioning that while this old archives room still houses filing cabinets, it's now primarily used for storage.
If this was just a prank aimed at you, it would've been no big deal. Under normal circumstances, you'd lean into the game—either play along with the prankster for fun or catch them red-handed.
But why would this "culprit" deliberately lead you to the old archives room and start searching through its contents? What exactly are they after?

...In the darkness, heavy footsteps and the sound of fabric dragging across the floor gradually approach. The two of you are trapped in a deadly game of cat and mouse within the confines of this room.
Whether they're after the archives or you, now isn't the time to reveal yourself. You have no weapons or your terminal with you—just the <color=#fb9259>shackles</color>.
You hold your breath and squeeze into the narrow gap between the nearest cabinet and the wall.
A shadow peels itself from the darkness, gliding past where your noise has betrayed you. After checking the door, they resume drifting between the filing cabinets.
Do they believe you've already left? Is that why they've resumed searching so intently? You can't quite make sense of their behavior.

Few people would be interested in MBCC archives—only those researching Sinners or seeking internal DisCity intelligence. Confidential files no longer remain here, but that's a fact outsiders are not aware of.
Since it's not actually some supernatural entity, this will be much easier to handle.
Their sloppy movements betray them—no professional, just an amateur playing at danger. You believe you can manage this alone.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Visiting MBCC in the dead of night? May I ask what brings you here?
You step out from your hiding place and confidently position yourself in the middle of the pathway, deliberately kicking over a box at your feet.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's no point in hiding, and these ghost games are amateur hour. Why not have a proper conversation instead?
You casually rub your wrist, ready to activate your shackles at a moment's notice.
In the darkness, you sense a cold, silent presence approaching from behind. A sudden chill of dread slithers like a snake, slowly climbing from your ankles up your legs, your waist...
You spin around with quick reflexes, but your opponent moves even faster—your fingers only manage to graze the edge of their clothing.

Holding your breath, you wait for the perfect moment to unleash your shackles. The familiar cold presence returns, but this time, a pair of equally cold hands creep up from behind, wrapping around your neck.
Just as those hands are about to tighten around your throat, you suddenly grab the intruder's wrists—
Ow, ow...
A red light flashes, forcing the hands around your neck to release their grip. With the slightest push, you send the intruder stumbling backward.
A familiar voice cries out in protest as a heavy thud follows.
You reach out with your slightly trembling hand to find the light switch. With a click, the room is instantly flooded with light.

The sight before you leaves you torn between laughter and speechlessness: a familiar figure has tumbled awkwardly into a box of plastic rubber ducks, her legs flailing as she struggles to free herself.
Her desperate wriggling sets off a chorus of squeaky quacks from the rubber ducks. Several are squeezed out of the box, landing on the floor with little plastic plops.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Ah... Don't come any closer! Don't... look at me...
Graves's face turns bright red with embarrassment at the "rubber duck symphony." She covers her face with her hands to hide from your gaze.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: This was supposed to be our perfect reunion... Sob... And I've ruined it...
Graves's words tremble with wounded pride, her voice fraying at the edges. A cobweb clings to her hair, and her clothes are smudged with dust, giving her a thoroughly disheveled appearance.
You survey the storage room, now in complete disarray from your chaotic encounter, and let out a sigh out of both resignation and amusement.
With so many Sinners at the Bureau, and since you never expected this "intruder" to be Graves, her sudden appearance catches you completely off guard.
You bend down and gently remove the cobweb from her hair, then take hold of her hands that shield her face, applying gentle pressure.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'd like you to explain exactly what happened back there.
